title: Agent routes require the backend secret
shows: Agent and Worker routes refuse callers without the shared secret. With it, the backend acts for the User named in the body, which is the documented trust model.
limits: The secret itself is the boundary; rotation and per-request signing are open (risk 3).

checks.label: Documented open risk: the secret alone acts for any User
checks.detail: with the secret and B's user ID → 200; returns B's records: true
